BETA Close X Pets At Home Group Plc announced that between August 24 and August 28, 2026, it purchased 640,278 of its ordinary shares as part of its share buyback program, with prices ranging from 212.4 GBp to 219.0 GBp. Following these purchases, the company's remaining ordinary shares in issue will be 440,857,855, with no shares held in treasury, resulting in a total of 440,857,855 voting rights. These purchased shares will be cancelled. Disclaimer* Pets At Home Group Plc 01 September 2026 1 Sept 2026 Pets at Home Group Plc Transaction in Own Shares Pets at Home Group Plc (the "Company"), announces that, in the period Monday 24 August 2026 to Friday 28 August 2026, it purchased in aggregate 640,278 of its ordinary £0.01 shares ("Ordinary Shares") through Deutsche Bank AG, London Branch (trading for these purposes as Deutsche Numis) ("Deutsche Numis"), in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme announced on 24 June 2026 ("Share Buyback Programme"). Date Aggregate Volume Lowest price paid (GBp) Highest price paid (GBp) Weekly weighted Average Price paid per share (GBp) 24/08/2026 150,000 212.4 214.8 213.9155 25/08/2026 120,000 214.0 217.0 216.1977 26/08/2026 120,000 215.8 219.0 217.3165 27/08/2026 150,000 213.4 217.2 214.8419 28/08/2026 100,278 212.4 214.8 214.2410 The purchased shares will be cancelled. Following the purchase of these shares, the remaining number of Ordinary Shares in issue will be 440,857,855 with no shares held in treasury. Therefore, the total voting rights in the Company will be 440,857,855. This figure for the total number of voting rights may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, the Company under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.
